title: Music Repack by VIVO_GAME_195
description: This project will contain remakes of music records in Minecraft. For the most part, there are mashups with Mellstroy, and some are in Russian
body:
# Music Repack by VIVO_GAME_195

A simple resource pack that replaces Minecraft's music disc tracks with a custom mashup.

## Features

* Replaces the music played by music discs.
* Custom mashup tracks instead of the original Minecraft music.
* Lightweight resource pack with no gameplay changes.
* Supports Russian language.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5+
* Tested up to version 26.1.2

## Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Move the `.zip` file to your `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable the pack in Minecraft's Resource Packs menu.

Enjoy your favorite mashup tracks while exploring the world of Minecraft!
